payload.title: File:Proapteryx.png
payload.description_html:
Interpretive illustration of holotype right femur of Proapteryx micromeros NMNZ S.53324 in caudal view. Scale bar is 10 mm.
Reference: Worthy TH, Worthy JP, Tennyson AJD, Salisbury SW, Hand SJ, Scofield RP (2013) Miocene fossils show that kiwi (Apteryx, Apterygidae) are probably not phyletic dwarves. Paleornithological Research 2013, Proceedings of the 8th International Meeting of the Society of Avian Paleontology and Evolution.
